gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests that the Symmetry010 calendar rejects the leap-week day (December 37) in years that are not leap years.

In Symmetry010, only leap years gain
ADDED i2: The leap-week day only exists in leap years.
ADDED i3: Proleptic years that are NOT Symmetry010 leap years, so December has no day 37.
